null_control.data_generating_process: Independent fair Bernoulli directions; predictor is previous direction
null_control.interpretation: Overlapping predictor/outcome sequences within paired weeks can induce a spurious within-week association under an IID null. This is a targeted diagnostic, not a general proof of validity of the replacement interval.

policy: Internal independent implementation, not third-party certification. Recompute frozen study from currently cached cleaned candles; compare counts/rates only if dataset hash matches. Estimate marginal rate difference with 28-calendar-day clustered influence standard error and normal Bonferroni interval across all 192 combinations; approximate and not guaranteed valid under dependence across clusters. Contrast with original within-week estimand. Historical split is exploratory, not untouched holdout. For direction hypotheses only, choose long or short from early conditional open-to-close returns, then measure later conditional open-to-close returns net of hypothetical fixed round-trip costs and compare same-direction unconditional returns; no fills, slippage model, roll-adjusted data or trade execution claim. No automatic promotion.
unresolved: No independent vendor feed or point-in-time snapshot archive.
No exact futures exchange-session calendar, contract-roll or fill simulation.
Historical splits are exploratory; no prospective evidence is promoted.
Six-month prospective batches cannot satisfy the 30-cluster minimum; their marginal diagnostics remain descriptive until a separately registered longer evaluation is available.
Within-week conditioning can answer a different question from unconditional marginal association.
Only Discovery V2 is recalculated; other engines need separate validation.
